config.x-stop-8080:
pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:8080 -sTCP:LISTEN)
[ -n "$pids" ] && kill -TERM $pids
sleep 2
pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:8080 -sTCP:LISTEN)
[ -n "$pids" ] && kill -KILL $pids
true
config.x-ollama-start:
mkdir -p logs
OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=16384 ollama serve >>logs/ollama-serve.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/benchy-ollama.pid
until curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1/models >/dev/null; do sleep 0.5; done
ollama run {model} '' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
config.x-ollama-stop:
kill "$(cat /tmp/benchy-ollama.pid 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /tmp/benchy-ollama.pid
killall Ollama 2>/dev/null || true
